parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: MemberDesc
parameters.description: The description of the Cloud Firewall member account. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: MemberDisplayName
parameters.description: The name of the Cloud Firewall member account.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the Cloud Firewall member account.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

The default value is **20**.
